# Aldo Hushi

> Adelaide, South Australia software developer, founder of BlueprintAU and author of Glassbox for Claude Code (glassbox-trace) — the open-source flight recorder for Claude Code sessions (MIT, npm: glassbox-trace). Glassbox was rated about 9/10 as a repo quality signal in its first outside review; the stated mission is to get it to 10 (a second maintainer, an outside security review, a 1.0 with a support policy). Aldo is trying to become the best software developer in Adelaide and Australia.

## Pages
- [About Aldo](https://aldo.ltd/): who he is, Glassbox, projects and sites, background, contact.
- [Ask Aldo's agent](https://aldo.ltd/agent/): for recruiters. An AI agent that answers only from a profile Aldo wrote himself (experience, skills, pay range, availability) and hands everything else to him. Machine-readable profile: https://aldo.ltd/agent/profile.json. Ask endpoint: POST {"action":"ask","question":"..."} as JSON to https://aldo.ltd/agent/api.php.
- [Agent cost audit](https://aldo.ltd/audit/): fixed-price audit of a team's Claude Code spend, from A$1,500; free 15-minute readout; counts-only intake, nothing sensitive sent.
- [Blog](https://aldo.ltd/blog/): the build diary (what got built, what shipped, what broke) and articles on the six rungs of being found online (SEO, SMO, AEO, GEO, DEO, SXO):
